description: M27 loot affix table — Diablo-style modifier system for weapons + armor + tools + cosmetics. 30+ affixes across 5 rarity tiers (Common / Magic / Rare / Legendary / Unique). Each affix has stat modifier + tradeoff + visual cue + lore. Feeds M27 loot roster + progression loop. Per DR-027 combat-base + DR-011 retention loop.
